description: This file defines the OmiProxy class implementing the IOmiProxy interface, providing methods for mounting and unmounting encrypted bundles, and managing error listeners within the omi namespace.

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: A class implementing the IOmiProxy interface, providing methods for managing encrypted bundles and error listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts an encrypted bundle given its identifier and file paths, returns success status.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts the encrypted bundle identified by the given id.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener and returns a tag for identification.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters an error listener using its tag.
